5034-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5034-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2728-5147-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5147-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5147-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5078-6556-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

2034-4679-6821-7895.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Little Bear.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-7827-7830-7832.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7832.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

549-2685-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-3197-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

969-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4871-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
4094-4871-5626.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Kaya.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2.
4094-4871-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

1090-4605-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Restoration Angel.
Restoration Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Restoration Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5256-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-5256-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

1563-2457-4460-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-6972-7155.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1849-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-3557-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-3557-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

290-1661-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

567-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

104-5070-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5070-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

944-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

38-301-1453.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-1453.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

997-1808-2837.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-1808-2837.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

372-1621-2885.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-2885.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Abdel Adrian and exiling Rescue the Foal.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5060-5078-5243.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
5060-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

594-2034-4052.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Crab" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
594-2034-4052.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Crab enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2696-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
2696-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping Coretapper and Magistrate's Scepter and causing you to gain two life.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4474-4639-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Morphling.
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
4474-4639-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Morphling triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

313-2034-2785.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
313-2034-2785.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mardu Warshrieker, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Mardu Warshrieker from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Mardu Warshrieker enters the battlefield, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.
